requirements.text: Separate non-isolated driver study for integrated diffuser-plus-LED module; most electronics in base; no dimming.
requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Candidate documents all owner constraints and preserves historical isolated designs.

requirements.text: Choose a regulated LED operating point without inheriting the 8S/24V limit.
requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Calculate 60/72/90/108V operating scenarios at 8W; exact current, LED count and voltage envelope remain unapproved.

requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Before release agree an optical acceptance band around 800lm and demonstrate it with selected LED bins/CCT, stabilized temperatures, diffuser and calibrated measurements.

requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Confirm target market/rated supply before schematic and establish complete startup/continuous/fault voltage range.

requirements.text: Bound startup, open/short/reconnect, component faults and thermal behavior.
requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Before schematic acceptance document numeric limits and current corner calculations; release requires physical fault verification.

requirements.text: All driver/output/LED conductors treated as mains-referenced.
requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Before schematic accept insulation architecture and applicable standards/test matrix; before placement accept assembly interfaces/accessibility; release requires complete-product safety evidence.

requirements.text: Choose actual fabrication and assembly process.
requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Owner confirms proposed service/stackup/finish/assembly scope or a documented alternative. No supplier capability or quote is inferred from example geometry.

requirements.text: Use exact verified and obtainable parts.
requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Full datasheet/package/pinout, exact orderable suffix and credible procurement route exist before capture; do not substitute product briefs for missing limits.

requirements.text: Approve independently derived pin-level intent before capture.
requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Every physical pin and NC reason comes from requirements and exact datasheets; record real human acceptance; compare actual exported netlist after capture.

requirements.text: Measure achievable board size rather than inventing an enclosure.
requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Before placement approve actual outline, height, connector location, insulation/thermal assumptions and assembly access; 40x25mm is only an exploratory goal.

requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Determine actual applicable EN editions and limits; retain conducted/radiated emissions, immunity, harmonics/DF/PF and PstLM/SVM measurement results before release.

requirements.text: Keep BOM and assembly simple with reasonable cost.
requirements.basis: Owner interview in current chat, 2026-11-19; proposals explicitly identified in README.md
requirements.acceptance: Compare complete priced BOM/process at a named quantity/date before purchasing; no unverified price or fit claims.

requirements.text: Define environmental, thermal and service-life design conditions.
requirements.basis: Owner requires usable compliant driver; independent draft review identified missing explicit verification gates.
requirements.acceptance: Before schematic acceptance record rated/minimum ambient, intended fixture/orientations, thermal path, capacitor case/lifetime target, LED junction limit and corresponding evidence plan. No inherited numeric limit silently becomes approved.

requirements.basis: Owner requires usable compliant driver; independent draft review identified missing explicit verification gates.
requirements.acceptance: Before release retain actual tests against the approved standards/classification: insulation, accessibility during removal/replacement, abnormal operation, residual energy and relevant thermal/fire requirements. CAD review alone cannot satisfy this requirement.

requirements.text: Verify startup and fault response physically.
requirements.basis: Owner requires usable compliant driver; independent draft review identified missing explicit verification gates.
requirements.acceptance: Before release record measured normal/corner and fault matrices for startup, open LED/removal, short LED/output, component faults, contact bounce/reconnection, brownout, thermal response, surge/inrush and discharge against numeric limits approved before schematic acceptance.

requirements.text: Define LED/optical selection criteria before driver selection.
requirements.basis: Owner requires usable compliant driver; independent draft review identified missing explicit verification gates.
requirements.acceptance: Before schematic acceptance agree first CCT/CRI, target flux band around 800lm, intended diffuser loss range, operating-temperature/bin assumptions and cold/hot electrical LED envelope. Final physical verification remains REQ-LIGHT.

requirements.basis: Owner requires usable compliant driver; independent draft review identified missing explicit verification gates.
requirements.acceptance: Before schematic acceptance create a structured two-endpoint interface contract with selected voltage/current envelopes, physical connector/pin identities, startup/fault behavior and owner; no pin identity or numeric bound may be inferred from an unapproved CAD draft.
